name: Lunalight Baker
original_name: ルナライト・ベイカー
source: The magician-in-training Lunalight who wants to understand love in order to become a full-fledged magician. Her hobby is watching the starry sky.
translation: The magician-in-training Lunalight who wants to understand love in order to become a full-fledged magician. Her hobby is watching the starry sky.
